channel.title: Comments for page "New Faces: Overture"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "New Faces: Overture"

item.title: You got me
item.content:encoded:
I love when the researchers are humanized beyond their jobs. I've always had a sweet spot for knowing how these people live their lives and interact with one another. Because there is no real canon in articles I rarely get to have that craving satisfied by seeing relationships and friendships live in the world but this definitely gave me exactly what I love.

Big happy +1 from me.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: I've described this piece to Grigori as Lynchian: the surreal tone and unexpected left-turns the characters make present an odd, but somehow natural, emotional atmosphere. It makes me feel things. Just what an overture should do! Terrific work.

item.content:encoded: They have not, also they probably won’t be seen again. Think of this as a tone piece. Obvs the author can speak to this more… but it’s setting the mood.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
this is a really bold and involved start, with an emotional arc that stands up well on its own - good job on that!

if i were to point out one place for improvement, it'd be in the placing of the story - the physical setting, since the mountains are such a tangible part of feeling out your ending. or even where the cast stands organisationally in within the Foundation, beyond 'generic research drones'.. i think knowing more about them would have helped a little more, especially for an introductory piece to "new faces" (though pls correct me if these characters actually have showed up before).
